name: replica-studio
description: Plataforma local de produção audiovisual assistida por IA

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @replica/api" "npm run dev -w @replica/worker" "npm run dev -w @replica/web"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,worker -c blue,green "npm run start -w @replica/api" "npm run start -w @replica/worker"
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke
